title: Parts and ports: selected source-unit audit
scope: All eight Table 9 cells, four Table 10 cells and the 18 parts / 20 ports graphical-production occurrences. Every selected local alternative has a representative asset, a partial match with explicit limits, or a documented deferral. This is not whole-language coverage or renderer conformance.
method: Visually inspected pinned source pages alongside text extraction. LocalAlternativesAudited means that the explicit forms in the selected source unit, imported dependencies and source issues have been recorded and assigned a rendering disposition. It does not mean all dependency productions, model combinations or rendering cases are implemented. Source-cell and production counts stay separate.
